notes.subject: gibor ha-sheloshim ve-'al ha-sheloshim
notes.rationale: 'muganw la jaw, ani muganw ɲɛmɔgɔ' — KSV fɔ 'among the thirty and above the thirty'; olu kɔrɔ kelen ye 'gibor' la (mugansɛgɛnw) ani kelen kɔ fɛ (kelen-kelen 30 mara la).

notes.subject: a tun ye
notes.rationale: Kɔgɔjirannen min bɛ Heburukan ka kuma-waleko fan dɔ la; a ma sɛbɛnHeburukan kɔnɔ.

notes.subject: sheloshim/sheloshim
notes.rationale: Kɔɔ tilennen fila 'muganw' — filanan kelen bɛ fɔlɔ ka janya; Bamanankan ma a jira ka ɲɛ.

translation: O Benayaw de ye muganw la jaw ye, ani ⟨a tun ye⟩ muganw ɲɛmɔgɔ ye; a ka mara kɔnɔ, Amitsabad a den ye don.
